subject: Recap: Redwood demo + procurement next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Thompson <eli.thompson@acme-fintech.com>, Maya Rodriguez <maya.rodriguez@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, michael.grant@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Redwood demo + procurement next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the clear feedback and the discussion about where Redwood could help reduce inference costs and lock in predictable latency for your customer-facing flows. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- What we showed: hosted API for dev testing + Dedicated for production with reserved capacity, model pinning, and SLA options.
- Key decision criteria you mentioned: predictable latency under 200ms P95, data isolation for regulated products, and predictable unit cost.
- Economic buyer: Eli (confirmed) — pricing/commitment to be decided by procurement + finance.
- Security/Legal: Maya (procurement) — onboarding + vendor risk questions.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Marissa (me) to share SOW draft, W-9, COI, and onboarding checklist — attached.
2) Maya / procurement to confirm whether Acme requires a PO, vendor portal registration, or any other paperwork, and share the vendor onboarding form if you have one.
3) If PO + terms look good, aim for a December 1 target for signed PO and kickoff the Dedicated provisioning the following week.

Questions for you: who on the Acme finance team handles PO/invoicing (name & billing email)? Any preferred invoice cadence (Net30/Net45)? Also, are there standard insurance limits or contract redlines we should expect?

Attachments: Redwood_SOW-draft.docx (SOW draft), Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (checklist)

Thanks — I'll follow up with the docs and loop Vivek and Michael for any technical/commercial clarifications.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

From: Maya Rodriguez <maya.rodriguez@acme-fintech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Eli Thompson <eli.thompson@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-fintech.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood demo + procurement next steps

Thanks for the clear recap, Marissa — great to meet you both. A few procurement items on our side:

- Yes, Acme requires a formal PO for vendor spend > $10k.
- We also require completion of our vendor onboarding form (attached). Can you confirm who will complete the vendor questionnaire on Redwood's side?
- Required docs: completed onboarding form, W-9, COI (certificate of insurance), and a copy of the SOW or purchase schedule.
- Finance contact: Dana Li (dana.li@acme-fintech.com); billing email: ap-invoices@acme-fintech.com.
- Target timeline: if we get the paperwork by Thursday 11/26 we can route for approval and aim for a signed PO by 2026-12-01, assuming no contract redlines.

Question: will Redwood accept our standard PO terms or do you require a docu-sign flow? Also please send your preferred billing contact and remit-to details.

Attaching: Acme_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

Best,
Maya Rodriguez
Head of Procurement | Acme Fintech
maya.rodriguez@acme-fintech.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Rodriguez <maya.rodriguez@acme-fintech.com>, Eli Thompson <eli.thompson@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, michael.grant@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Recap: Redwood demo + procurement next steps

Maya — thanks for the quick reply and the onboarding form. Looping in a couple folks from our side to make this as smooth as possible:
- Michael Grant (Solutions Engineering) to confirm any security/technical evidence you need for vendor risk.
- Lauren Bishop (Sales Ops) for pricing confirmation and approvals if anything needs escalation.

To answer your questions:
1) PO: we accept Acme's PO. Please send PO to billing@redwood.ai (PDF preferred).
2) Documents: Attached are Redwood_W9.pdf and Redwood_COI.pdf.
3) Vendor questionnaire: Marissa or Michael can complete the onboarding form; Michael will take the lead on technical/security sections.
4) Billing/remit: Redwood, Inc.
   - Billing contact: invoices@redwood.ai
   - Remit-to: Redwood Inference, 220 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105
   - Preferred invoice cadence: Net30 (we can discuss Net45 if needed).

If there are any standard contract redlines from Legal, please share them; for small operational changes we can usually accept an addendum. For anything material (data residency, indemnity caps), we'll loop Legal.

Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf, Redwood_COI.pdf

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Maya Rodriguez <maya.rodriguez@acme-fintech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Eli Thompson <eli.thompson@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-fintech.com, dana.li@acme-fintech.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood demo + procurement next steps

Thanks Vivek — that helps. Quick confirmation from procurement/finance: 
- We will complete the vendor onboarding form and return by end of day 2026-11-26.
- Finance (Dana Li) will prepare a PO and we expect to have a signed PO ready by 2026-12-01 for the initial committed capacity.
- PO will be sent to billing@redwood.ai (per your instructions). Our standard PO will include standard Acme terms; if Redwood needs contract redlines please flag them before routing for signature.

I'll send the completed onboarding form to this thread when ready. For the purposes of scheduling provisioning, please assume a December 6 provisioning date once PO is received.

Attachments: Acme_PO_stub.pdf (we'll populate and return as PDF with signature)

Best,
Maya Rodriguez
Head of Procurement | Acme Fintech
maya.rodriguez@acme-fintech.com
